title: The KGB gives the Tsar's box seat to Malmgren instead of Kissinger

tellings.quote: Zar and one of the KB people said, "Henry, not tonight. Not tonight. That seat is for Dr. Mal.

plain: In Moscow in 1982, at a performance with Henry Kissinger, the presidential adviser Harold Malmgren says the KGB stopped Kissinger from taking the Tsar's old box seat, saying "Henry, not tonight. That seat is for Dr. Mal." Malmgren tells Michels this as something that happened to him, a sign of how much weight the Soviets gave him.
